name: Agathion, Leonal Class
body:
This lion-headed humanoid has golden fur, sharp teeth, and long cat-like claws on its hand and feet.

A leonal is a lion-like agathion, noble and fierce. Though gentle with their families and patient with strangers on their home plane, in battle leonals are deadly foes of evil and cruelty. They hunt fiends and other evil monsters, silently tailing their prey until they find the right time to leap and slash. Leonals pride themselves on their hunting prowess, and few land creatures can match their speed. Although capable of using weapons, the majority of leonals prefer to battle evil with tooth and claw.

A Leonal stands 6 feet and weigh 270 lbs. on average. Males usually have manes of either dark gold or black. Females do not have manes, but may have longer hair on the back of the head and neck.

Medium outsider (agathion, extraplanar, good)

Alignment: Any. (Normally good)

Hit Die: d10.

Class Skills

The Leonal’s class skills are Acrobatics (Dex), Handle Animal (Cha), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (any one) (Int), Perception (Wis), Sense Motive (Wis), Spellcraft (Int), and Stealth (Dex); Racial Modifiers: +4 Stealth, +12 Jump

Skill Ranks per Level: 6 + Int modifier.

Class Features

All of the following are class features of the Leonal.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency: Leonals are proficient with all simple weapons and martial weapons. They are not proficient with any type of armor or shield. Armor interferes with a class name’s gestures, which can cause her spells with somatic components to fail (see Arcane Spells and Armor).

Senses: darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent
Immune: electricity, petrification
Languages: Common, Celestial, Draconic, Infernal; speak with animals , truespeech

Lay on hands: as an equivalent level paladin

Melee: bite (Per Level + Str + plus grab), 2 claws (Per Level + Str)

Protective Aura (Su)

Against attacks made or effects created by evil creatures, this ability provides a +4 deflection bonus to AC and a +4 resistance bonus on saving throws to anyone within 20 feet of the leonal. Otherwise, it functions as a magic circle against evil effect and a lesser globe of invulnerability, both with a radius of 20 feet (caster level equals leonal’s HD).

Roar (Su)
Up to three times per day, a leonal can emit a powerful roar as a standard action. Each roar affects a 60-foot cone with the effects of a holy word spell and also deals 2d6 points of sonic damage to all creatures in the area (Fortitude save negates). This is a sonic effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.
